description: Na₆Mg(SO₄)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.92 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 65°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.45 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 65°. There are four shorter (2.06 Å) and two longer (2.08 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-62°. There are three shorter (1.47 Å) and one longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond length. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-44°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.49 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃S tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃S tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one S atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one S atom.
